answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farms from flooding a market. Each new agent posts a 10 POA bond, then five randomly chosen peers check its work, as timber is graded before building. A fake that passes once faces another random draw next epoch, so a comet-like burst of 1000 fakes must fund 10000 POA in bonds and survive repeated checks, while an honest agent pays only one 10 POA bond, refunded after clean audits. Only verified agents trade at dawn, and no burst of new accounts can outrun the audit queue.
